description: Google Cloud Vision-compatible OCR (text detection and recognition). The expected endpoints are POST /v1/images:annotate (features TEXT_DETECTION and DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION, REST only) and GET /health; suppliers MAY expose more of the Cloud Vision surface or extensions but consumers MUST NOT depend on it. This service is model-agnostic: suppliers choose their own OCR model and weights, so recognized text, language coverage, and polygons vary and are not guaranteed by the protocol.

rpc_types.backend_hint: Cloud Vision-compatible images:annotate server on :8080 (image-inference-server, ocr endpoint enabled); mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/images:annotate and GET /health are expected. Request body is Cloud Vision JSON: requests[{image: {content: <base64>}, features: [{type: TEXT_DETECTION | DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION}]}]. Image URLs (image.source.imageUri) are off by default and MUST NOT be relied on. gRPC is not served.

serving.backend: Any Google Cloud Vision-compatible server exposing POST /v1/images:annotate (REST) and GET /health. Recommended: image-inference-server (Rust gateway + NVIDIA Triton Inference Server) with the ocr endpoint enabled. Suppliers choose their own OCR model; no specific weights are mandated. The operator is responsible for the license of the model they serve.
serving.notes: Use a server with dynamic batching so one backend serves many concurrent requests. Recommended model: PP-OCRv6 medium det + rec (Apache-2.0); PP-OCRv6 small on CPU-only hosts. Keep image URL fetching disabled. It is recommended to isolate the model behind pokt-ml-sidecar and to front it with the HA RelayMiner. See the docs in specs[0] for the full runbook.
